name: Semantic role invariance
observed: Dynamic colors retain semantic purposes across appearances.
rule: Map roles to theme-specific tokens; do not bind component meaning to hex.
limit: Verify contrast per theme and material.

name: Adjacency-aware palette
observed: Curated categorical sequence prioritizes neighboring differentiation.
rule: Audit adjacency edges as well as global pairs.

name: Reserved signal
observed: Functional colors have context-specific roles including focus.
rule: Reserve focus and error signals for their intended roles.

name: Perceptual fidelity
observed: Uneven gradients can distort quantitative perception; color bars matter.
rule: Prefer established scientific ramps; preserve domain and legend.

name: Editorial accent discipline
observed: Proposed research note uses neutral reading surface and pink accent.
rule: Separate editorial identity from quantitative encodings.
limit: One proposed note, not universal FT policy; full article not inspected.

name: Explicit scale contract
observed: Scale type, domain, pivot and scheme independently configurable.
rule: Declare field, scale type, domain, pivot, legend and missing policy before colors.
limit: No interactive source execution in this review.
